description: A global dataset for steel aluminum and cement in-use stocks at 500 m gridded level 2000-2019 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Kun Sun et al. The anthropogenic material in-use stocks accumulated in products, buildings, and infrastructure are essential for satisfying basic human demands and ensuring well-being. They drive global resource demand and environmental impacts while representing valuable resource reservoirs for potential recycling through urban mining. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Image, ZIP, Raster. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 6599828907 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
